The source describes Gaussian boundaries using both plus/minus one fitted sigma and half-maximum wording; these are not mathematically equivalent. Preserve the author-reported64km mean and ambiguity without converting to FWHM.

Reported non-detection of an annual width cycle does not mean zero variability or constant width. Neither new mean is eligible for seasonal playback, annual extrema, whole-current ranking or geographic footprint inference.
